except Exception as e:

if not biz_ids:

            biz_placeholders = ','.join(['?' for _ in biz_ids])

    # ============================================================

    try:
        # Connect to Milvus

        print("Connected to Milvus successfully.")
        
        # Load sentence transformer for encoding search queries

        # Encode search terms

        search_vectors = model.encode(search_terms).tolist()
        
        # Access photo_vector collection

            if len(biz_ids) <= 100:

                biz_filter = ' || '.join(biz_filter_parts) if biz_filter_parts else ''

            results = collection.search(

                anns_field="embedding",
                param=search_params,

                output_fields=["business_id", "photo_id", "label", "caption"]

                    'photo_id': p[0],
                    'caption': p[2],
                    'label': p[3],
                    'distance': None
                })
            print(f"Fallback found {len(photo_rows)} photo(s) across {len(photo_biz_ids)} businesses.")
        except Exception as e2:
            print(f"Photo fallback error: {e2}")
    
    # ============================================================

                    print(f"  Graph confirmed: Danny reviewed '{record['business_name']}' with {len(record['photo_ids'])} photo(s)")
